title: 第21章 茫然的曲柔第22章 吕韦与陈岚
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
“下来吧，你太惹眼了！”
李蒙掐诀向下一按。
天空盘旋的灵剑突然朝着大地俯冲而下。
只见一道金色的流光从小竹峰上空一闪而过。
灵剑“轰”的一声坠入了竹林中。
只见一股气浪炸开，卷起了滚滚竹页。
随着竹叶飘落，一切尘埃落定时。
巨大的灵剑笔直的插在了小竹林中。
五分之一的剑身插入了地中。
“看看你能持续多长时间吧！”
三个时辰后。
看着依旧存在的灵剑，李蒙面露沉吟之色。
“看来不被击溃，在符宝中的灵力耗尽之前就能一直存在。”
灵剑本就会自行吸收灵气。
这无疑又增加了存在的时间。
“神霄符果然惊天地泣鬼神！”
看着眼前的金色大宝剑，李蒙满意的点了点头。
双手掐诀。
“回来！”
灵剑突然金光大冒。

化为一张符箓钻入了李蒙腰间的储物袋。
符宝虽然可以认主。
但只有金丹期修士才能炼化存于识海中。
一旦炼化，就能作为本命法宝使用。
李蒙抬头看向了内门方向。
“该去见一个人了！”
李蒙飞身而起，苍老的身体冲出了竹林。
一把飞剑滴溜溜的飞出了储物袋。
李蒙脚踩飞剑，御剑远去了。
内门，云上峰。
“外门弟子李蒙，拜见曲师叔！”
李蒙御剑凌空，作揖行礼。
“又是他！”
几道剑光从四面八方的山头激射而出，御剑而来。
筑基修士御剑的速度可比练气修士快多了。
content_en:
"Come down, you're so eye-catching!"
Li Meng pinched his hand and pressed it down.
The spiritual sword hovering in the sky suddenly swooped down towards the earth.
I saw a golden stream of light flashing over Xiaozhu Peak.
The spirit sword crashed into the bamboo forest with a "boom".
A wave of air exploded, rolling up the bamboo leaves.
As the bamboo leaves fall, all the dust settles.
The huge spiritual sword was inserted straight into the small bamboo forest.
One-fifth of the sword blade was inserted into the ground.
"Let's see how long you can last!"
Three hours later.
Looking at the spirit sword that still existed, Li Meng looked thoughtful.
"It seems that if it is not defeated, it can exist until the spiritual power in the talisman is exhausted."
The spirit sword will absorb spiritual energy on its own.
This undoubtedly increases the time of existence.
"The Divine Sky Talisman really shocked the world and made ghosts and gods cry!"
Looking at the golden sword in front of him, Li Meng nodded with satisfaction.
Make a hand gesture.
"Come back!"
The spiritual sword suddenly glowed with golden light.
It turned into a talisman and got into the storage bag on Li Meng's waist.
Although the talisman can recognize its owner.
But only monks at the golden elixir stage can refine it and store it in the sea of ​​consciousness.
Once refined, it can be used as a natal magic weapon.
Li Meng raised his head and looked toward the inner door.
"It's time to meet someone!"
Li Meng flew up, and his old body rushed out of the bamboo forest.
A flying sword flew out of the storage bag.
Li Meng stepped on the flying sword, and the sword flew away.
Inner gate, clouds reach the peak.
"Outer disciple Li Meng, pay your respects to Master Qu!"
Li Meng raised his sword in the air and bowed in salute.
"It's him again!"
Several rays of sword light shot out from the mountains in all directions, and the sword came.
The sword-wielding speed of a foundation-building monk is much faster than that of a Qi-training monk.
